# Plugin contract fixture

`plugin-wave-url.txt` is generated by `IntegrationTest.javaProducesTheBrowserFixture` in [inferno-los-plugin at f29ca7e](https://github.com/ollieatkinson/inferno-los-plugin/blob/f29ca7e/src/test/java/com/infernolos/IntegrationTest.java). It is committed here so website CI needs only Node.js and Chromium.

The Java and TypeScript tests both assert the same fixed IL2 code. If the contract changes, update both repositories and regenerate this fixture from the plugin. To exercise fresh plugin output directly, set `INFERNO_PLUGIN_FIXTURE_PATH` to its `build/fixtures/wave-url.txt` when running browser tests. The normal suite does not require the plugin checkout or Java.
